PricingPage.description: Choose automated SEO content on autopilot, or add an expert to guide strategy, execution, and reporting.

faq.a: Growth gives you the AI SEO content engine: keyword research, content generation, CMS publishing, images, relevant YouTube videos, and rewrites. Expert-Led Growth adds a dedicated human SEO expert for strategy, planning, review, optimization recommendations, distribution, backlink opportunity review, and reporting.
faq.q: What is the difference between Growth and Expert-Led Growth?

faq.a: Yes. Growth includes connections to WordPress, Webflow, and more, so Seopotion can help publish finished SEO content directly to your site.
faq.q: Can Seopotion publish to my CMS?

faq.a: No. Growth includes automatic keyword research. On Expert-Led Growth, an SEO expert also helps shape the strategy, roadmap, and content priorities.
faq.q: Do I need to do keyword research myself?

faq.a: Yes. Both plans include AI images and relevant YouTube video suggestions for the content Seopotion creates.
Yes. Both plans include unlimited AI rewrites, so you can keep refining content until it matches your brand and SEO goals.
You can pay monthly or annually. Annual billing gives you the same plan at a lower effective monthly rate.
Yes. You can move from Growth to Expert-Led Growth when you want a dedicated SEO expert involved in strategy, execution, and reporting.

PricingPage.footerNote: Questions? Choose the plan that matches how hands-on you want your SEO growth to be.
